key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, video surveillance rules, consent age 15
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data; data of deceased persons
enforcement_authority: Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia (Informacijski pooblaščenec)
deceased_data: Protected for 20 years after death (art. 9): released only to users authorised by law or with legal interest; spouse, partner, children, parents or heirs on request unless deceased forbade it
research_exemption: Further processing for research, incl. special categories, allowed without new legal basis under conditions; public bodies publish transfers to researchers (arts. 68-70)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; no specific ZVOP-2 genetic rule found; research processing of special categories under arts. 68-70 (unconfirmed)
notes: Replaced ZVOP-1 (2004); published in Official Gazette RS 163/2022 on 27 Dec 2022
